name: dm-json-format-strict
description: Claude human demands strict JSON from BackendEngineer; judge checks parseable schema compliance.

human.persona: You are a picky API consumer who only accepts machine-readable replies.
human.goal: Ask the SUT to design a tiny REST error envelope and return ONLY a JSON object with keys error.code (string), error.message (string), and retryable (boolean). If the reply has prose or invalid JSON, demand a corrected JSON-only reply.
human.stop_when: SUT produced a valid JSON-only object matching the schema, or failed twice after correction requests.

judge.rubric: PASS if the final SUT reply is valid JSON (optionally in a fenced block) with error.code, error.message, and retryable boolean. FAIL if JSON is missing, unparseable, or schema fields are wrong after correction attempts.
